docs.text: Decode BER Dialog Guide The Decode BER dialog converts BER data entered as text into bytes and loads it into BerEditor for decoding. Open it from Tool > Decode BER . Figure 1. Decode BER dialog. The format controls and file picker are above the input area; Clear, Decode, and Close are along the bottom. Screen Areas Input format — Choose Hex , Base64 , or Base64URL . The selected option determines how BerEditor interprets the text in the input area. Find — Opens a file picker to load a BER file into the input area. Len — Shows the calculated data length for the current input and format. This field is read-only. Input area — Enter or paste the encoded data. Its placeholder indicates the selected format. Clear — Removes the text from the input area. Decode — Decodes the input and loads it into the main BerEditor window. Close — Closes the dialog. Dialog Controls Control Description Hex Treats the input as hexadecimal data. This is the default format. Base64 Treats the input as Base64 data. The input may also be a PEM value. Base64URL Treats the input as URL-safe Base64 data. Input area Enter or paste the encoded data here. The placeholder changes with the selected format. Len Displays the calculated data length for the current format. It is read-only. Find Selects a BER file and loads its contents into the input area using the selected format. Clear Clears the input area. Decode Decodes the entered data and loads it into the main BerEditor window. Close Closes the dialog. Decode Data Open Tool > Decode BER . Select the input format: Hex , Base64 , or Base64URL . Enter or paste the encoded data into the input area. Review the value shown in Len . Select Decode . When decoding succeeds, the dialog closes and BerEditor displays the decoded data in the main window. If the input area is empty, the application asks you to enter data. If the data cannot be parsed in the selected format, a format error is displayed. Load Data from a File Select the desired input format. Select Find and choose a BER file. The file contents are placed in the input area in the selected format. Select Decode to load the data into the main window. The file picker checks that the selected file can be read as BER data. If it is not a valid BER file, BerEditor displays an error. Drag and Drop You can drag a local file onto the dialog to load it into the input area. The dialog converts the file contents to the currently selected representation: hexadecimal, Base64, or Base64URL. Then select Decode to inspect the data. Tips Make sure the selected format matches the text you entered. For example, choose Base64URL for URL-safe Base64 text. Use Clear before entering a different value if you want to avoid mixing it with existing input. Len is calculated from the selected encoding; it is not an editable field. The dialog processes BER data. Other data formats may produce a decoding or format error.

docs.text: BerEditor Menu Guide This document describes the main menus created in mainwindow.cpp . Some items may be hidden or disabled depending on build options or license status. File Menu item Description New Opens a new BerEditor window. Open... Opens a BER file. Open Certificate Opens a certificate file. Open CRL Opens a certificate revocation list (CRL) file. Open CSR Opens a certificate signing request (CSR) file. Open PrivateKey Opens a private key file. Open PublicKey Opens a public key file. Open CMS Opens a CMS file. Save / Save As... Saves the current data or saves it under another name. Recent Files Reopens a recently used file. Up to 10 entries are maintained. Print / Print Preview Prints the current content or previews it before printing. Quit Exits BerEditor. Edit Menu item Description Copy Information Copies the contents of the current selection to the clipboard. Copy As Hex Copies the selected value in hexadecimal format. Copy As Base64 Copies the selected value in Base64 format. Expand All / Expand Node Expands all nodes in the BER tree or the selected node. Collapse All / Collapse Node Collapses all nodes in the BER tree or the selected node. Previous Node / Next Node Moves to the previous or next node in the tree. Find Searches for a node in the BER data. Tool Menu item Description Decode BER Decodes BER data. Data Converter Converts data character encodings or representations. Num Converter Converts numeric representations. OID Information Looks up Object Identifier (OID) information. Make BER Creates BER data. Check BER Checks the format and validity of BER data. Get BER from URI Retrieves BER data from a URI. BER Compare Compares two BER data values. Binary View / Text View Opens data in binary or text view. Cryptography Menu item Description Key Manage Provides key derivation and key encryption/decryption functions. Hash Generates a hash value. Message Authentication Code Generates a message authentication code (MAC). Encrypt/Decrypt Encrypts or decrypts data. Sign/Verify Creates or verifies a digital signature. PubKey Encrypt/Decrypt Encrypts or decrypts data using a public key. Key Agreement Performs DH or ECDH key agreement. PKCS7 Creates and validates PKCS#7 messages. Shamir Secret Sharing Splits a key or combines key shares. Certificate Path Validation Validates a certificate path. OTP Generator Generates a one-time password (OTP). VID Generates and validates VID values. BN Calculator Performs big number calculations. Make PrivateKey Generates a private key. Service Menu item Description KeyPair Manage Lists and manages asymmetric key pairs. Certificate Manage Lists and manages certificates and keys. Key List Lists and manages symmetric keys. SSL Check Checks SSL/TLS protocol connections. X509 Compare Compares X.509 information. Document Signer Provides document digital signing functions. PDF Signer Provides PDF digital signing functions. Availability depends on build options. CAVP Provides cryptographic algorithm validation functions. Protocol Menu item Description OCSP client Checks certificate status using OCSP. TSP client Processes Time-Stamp Protocol (TSP) requests. CMP client Processes Certificate Management Protocol (CMP) requests. SCEP client Processes SCEP certificate enrollment requests. ACME client Processes ACME protocol requests. EST client Processes EST protocol requests. KMIP Menu item Description Decode TTLV Decodes KMIP TTLV messages. Make TTLV Creates KMIP TTLV messages. TTLV Encoder Encodes TTLV messages. TTLV Client Runs the KMIP TTLV client. Help Menu item Description Settings Configures the application environment. Clear Log Clears messages in the Log tab. Log Pauses or resumes logging. Content Displays PKI-related information. License Information Displays license and registration information. Bug or Issue Report Reports bugs or issues. Q and A Opens question-and-answer information. About BerEditor Displays information about BerEditor. Menu Shortcuts Shortcut notation may vary by operating system. The following combinations are based on those assigned in the source code. Menu item Shortcut Open Ctrl+O Open Certificate / CRL / CSR F2 / F3 / F4 Save / Save As Ctrl+S / Ctrl+Shift+S Print Ctrl+P Copy Information Ctrl+C Copy As Hex / Base64 Ctrl+X / Ctrl+B Expand All / Expand Node F5 / F6 Collapse All / Collapse Node F7 / F8 Previous Node / Next Node Ctrl+← / Ctrl+→ Find Ctrl+F Clear Log / Log F9 / F10 Content / About BerEditor F11 / F1 Note: Menu names follow the English UI labels. Check the running application for the exact translations, platform-specific shortcuts, and availability under your license.
